title: AlienCraft : Kepler 22b
description: With this minecraft mod you can explore Kepler22b, a fareaway exoplanet with a unique flora, fauna, structures and equipments to craft for hours of gameplay !
body:
AlienCraft : Kepler 22b is a unique minecraft mod that will allow you to explore a brand new planet : Kepler 22b

Ride space rockets to a new world, encounter highly detailed ecosystems, each with a unique wildlife, flora and structures and experience the various dangers of the fareaway exoplanet Kepler 22b

 

Please note that this is an early iteration of the mod, and A LOT of bugs are expected.

If you encounter a bug you can report it in the comment section.

For any question regarding the mod's mecanics, content or even for bugs, feel free to join my discord server :


What is currently in the mod :

95% of the Alien jungle biome including :

-50+ new blocks and items, including space rockets, food sources, decorative block sets

-a foreign fauna including 7 unique alien species, each with unique abilities, behaviour, drops and purpose in gameplay

-a unique reactive flora that can both be harmfull and full of uses

-2 large structures, a medium one and 2 small structures

-Unique alien artifacts and technology including 0 gravity generators, gate generators, entity detectors, magic crystals...

-3 unique weapons with special abilities

-1 unique armor with custom effects

 

65% of the Alien desert biome including :

-2 unique creatures(read what's planned) with unique behaviour and gameplay use

-3 large structures, 3 different types of floating islands, 2 smaller structures

-22 unique blocks, 4 unique plants with unique uses

-15+ unique items and weapons, including flamethrowers, mining lasers, ancient creatures egg...

 

What is planned :

Not biome related :

-a space suit

-a kepler custom boss

For the desert :

-at least 2 more species unique to the desert, maybe more if i get good ideas

-1 more giant desert structure

-a couple of new items and weapons unique to the biome including an alien mining laser, 

 

for the forest biome :

-1 more weapons, another armor set, more interaction opportunities with the fauna and between the different mobs
